C0006.title: SEO Rank Manipulation Black Market: Exploiting Emulators for Fake Clicks to Deceive Search Engines
C0006.summary: Public typical cases show that operating manual traffic platforms and organizing fake clicks or visits can interfere with search engine ranking algorithms and constitute unfair competition. Such conduct organizes non-genuine user feedback at platform scale, influences rankings, traffic allocation, and commercial display opportunities, and harms search-service evaluation systems and normal business order, reflecting traffic manipulation, click fraud, and algorithm-adversarial risks in search scenarios.

references.title: Operating manual-traffic platform to manipulate search engine algorithms constitutes unfair competition — Beijing IP Court ruling in Baidu v. Woai
